gemforge - the Gemforge uses material from your chests (shroudlink mod)
=========================================================================
Standing at your base's Gemforge, you can use the material its gem actions need straight
from the chests within 40 m: it is lent into your backpack. Walk away and what is left
goes back into those chests. What you carried before stays yours. No addon needed.

REQUIRES the shroudlink core (shroudlink-core.zip).

INSTALL: unpack this zip into the server folder (where enshrouded_server.exe is), so that
gemforge.dll lands in shroudlink_mods. To switch it off, remove gemforge.dll.
